quote.text: I have two cars and lose track of which needs what

promise.text: How to track maintenance on two household cars

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "car"

lines.text: Give each vehicle its own history and schedule, then review both together.
Assign the next action so shared responsibility does not become a gap.

eyebrow.text: Set up both cars without mixing them

items.text: Give each car a unique label plus year, model and plate or VIN.
Create one service history and one schedule page per vehicle.
Read each odometer and record the reading, unit and date beside the vehicle identity.
List current concerns separately from scheduled work and paperwork renewals.
Name who will book, who will take the car and who will enter the final invoice.

line.text: Both sit in the same ranked list, most urgent first, each item saying which vehicle it belongs to.
